Over thelast several years,hospital inpatient revenue has been shrinking as more care shifts to outpatient settings,according to a

recent Deloitteanalysis ofhospitalrevenuetrends.2In the future, we expect some outpatient care will shift to virtual settings.To prepare,health care organizations should think about how these industry trends might line up with their investments in the coming years.

Behavioralhealth:In-personoffi cevisitsfor behavioralhealthwillbetheexception,and telehealthvisitswillbe therule,according to many of our interviewees. Executives discussed the potential of tele-behavioral health to treat depression, anxiety, substance abuse, and weight management, to name a few.Having access to behavioral health couldhelp improve the prevention and treatment of chronic conditions. People who struggle with depression,for example,canfind it difficult to adhere to treatment regimens or stick to a healthy dietor fitness plan.
